name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.
texts: If the ball is moved (blocker_moved is true), the agent must also acquire the matching key (has_door_key is true) at some point.
Pick up the target box (target_picked_up is true).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u0, blocker_moved&has_door_key&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u2, !has_door_key&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, has_door_key&!target_picked_up) -> u0
(u2, has_door_key&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u3, has_door_key) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !blocker_moved&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key&!target_picked_up, u2) -> -1
(u0, blocker_moved&has_door_key&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u2, !has_door_key&target_picked_up, u3) -> 1
(u2, has_door_key&!target_picked_up, u0) -> 1
(u2, has_door_key&target_picked_up, u1) -> 12
(u3, has_door_key, u1) -> 11
